I see you are experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or the amount of urine you produce?

REQUEST TEST: TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)

speaker: Doctor
text:
The TSH level is elevated, which suggests hypothyroidism. To confirm this, have you been experiencing constipation, dry skin, or hair loss?

REQUEST TEST: Free T4

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Hypothyroidism. Given the elevated TSH and low Free T4, your thyroid gland is underactive. Would you like me to discuss the treatment options, such as starting levothyroxine?
